request.subject: UNIT:CULT:CAPTAIN

layers.text: Redraw it as another member of the same society in the same blue robe, tall and thin: the pointed hood becomes a very tall straight spike, twice as tall as before, whose tip reaches the top edge of the image, and the robe is narrow; a pale cream stole hangs round the neck; one hand raises a small brass hand bell; a looped brass chain hangs from the other hand. No candle and no scroll. Keep the two cream eyes, the slippers, the thick black outline and the art style, on a transparent background.
